Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Faulkner
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 390 as introduced would exempt the Birmingham Regional Paratransit Consortium, Inc., doing business as ClasTran from state gasoline, motor fuel excise taxes, and inspection fees, which will decrease gasoline excise taxes and inspection fee receipts to the following funds by an undetermined amount for the remainder of the current fiscal year, and then annually as follows:
Annual Amount
Public Road and Bridge Fund
$26,000
Counties
$14,000
Municipalities
$2,500
Department of Conservation
$200
Department of Agriculture (Inspection Fee)
$300
Totals
$43,000
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
